verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a machine-readable API reference (OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, llms-api.txt, per-guide text exports) plus a sandbox environment (demo.ramp.com/demo-api.ramp.com) where developers can safely test API calls and simulate events without affecting production, which covers the 'runnable examples' spirit for API consumers/agents. However, there's no evidence of a traditional interactive browsable reference UI (e.g., embedded Swagger/Redoc try-it-out console) — the evidence is framed around raw OpenAPI JSON and CLI/agent access rather than an in-browser interactive explorer. missing for 10: explicit interactive API console/UI with clickable runnable examples, independent corroboration of the sandbox's interactivity beyond docs claims.
